invariants.rationale: Since the method always returns the result of a handleInsert or handleUpdate call, and both are expected to return non-null Iterators.
The partition is passed to partitioner.getBucketInfo and is expected to be a valid Integer.
partitioner is dereferenced in javaUpsertPartitioner.getBucketInfo(partition), thus must be non-null at this point.
instantTime is an operation time marker and is normally expected to be non-null for commit actions.
recordItr is passed through to either handleInsert or handleUpdate, so must be non-null to avoid exceptions.
